questions.question: What did the apostle Paul say he resolved to know while he was with the church in Corinth?

answers.text: Nothing except Jesus Christ and Him crucified
Nothing except the Law and the Prophets
Nothing except the wisdom of the Greeks

questions.question: Paul told the Corinthians his preaching did not rely on persuasive words of wisdom. What came with his message instead?

answers.text: A demonstration of the Spirit's power

questions.question: Paul said that if the rulers of this age had understood God's wisdom, what would they not have done?

answers.text: Burned the scroll of the prophet

questions.question: Paul wrote that no one can instruct the Lord. According to Paul, what do believers have?
